title: The Torn Scripture
text: The apostates have torn a holy book apart and nailed its pages to every door in the street. Each page has been rewritten in a careful hand, the old words crossed out and new ones written over them. The new words are worse.

options.label: The wisest reads the rewritten pages to learn what the Court truly believes.

outcomes.text: It is the Court's real creed, in their own hand.
It makes too much sense. They cannot unread it.

options.label: Gather the pages door by door to restore the book, whatever the Court thinks.

outcomes.text: The work is slow and careful, and the Court notices.

options.label: Burn every page so the new words spread no further.

outcomes.text: The Court comes running before the smoke clears.
